entries.name: voice_mission_start
entries.variant_description: A calm female pilot voice says in Chinese: Mission start. Keep formation and prepare to fire.

entries.name: voice_warning
entries.variant_description: An urgent female operator voice says in Chinese: Warning, enemy missiles incoming. Evade immediately.

entries.name: voice_powerup
entries.variant_description: A confident female onboard AI voice says in Chinese: Weapon system upgraded. Firepower increased.

entries.name: voice_boss_appears
entries.variant_description: A tense female commander voice says in Chinese: Huge hostile signal detected. Boss unit approaching.

entries.name: voice_victory
entries.variant_description: A bright female pilot voice says in Chinese: Target destroyed. Great job, pilot.
